runtimeFlags: 3-stage layer pipeline (qwen35 staged engine), one stage per NUC on its Arc B390 iGPU, activations over 2.5 GbE, greedy, batch 1
notes: Three ASUS NUCs (Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390 iGPU, 32 GB each, Windows 11) on one 2.5 GbE switch. The 40 layers of the INT4 export are split 14/13/13 across the three iGPUs; each token crosses the wire twice. decodeTps is the medium prompt (975 tokens after the chat template, 256 generated, temperature 0, thinking off) averaged over 3 timed repeats after 1 warm-up: (completion tokens - 1) / (request wall time - time to first token), where TTFT is a separate max_tokens=1 request; ttftMs is the same medium prompt's median. Whole chain drew 27.6 W during decode (0.65 tok/J); 6.1 GB GPU memory per node. GSM8K 40-question subset: 36/40. The same model whole on one of these NUCs decodes at 33 tok/s once the GPU window is raised, so the split is for memory headroom, not speed.
